name: UK energy price cap
summary: Ofgem announces the January cap on 25 Nov; Cornwall Insight forecasts a 26% rise from £1,723 to about £2,166
state: The cap for a typical dual-fuel household is £1,723 a year from 1 Oct to 31 Dec (Ofgem). As of 23 Nov Ofgem had not yet announced the January to March 2027 cap, which is due on 25 Nov. Cornwall Insight forecasts a 26% rise to about £2,166, the highest bill level since 2023 (IBTimes UK; Uswitch). The forecast rise is above the 20% Alert line.
for_you: Ofgem's announcement on 25 Nov will set bills from 1 January. Ofgem's energy price cap guide explains who it covers; Ofgem and Citizens Advice list help for those struggling to pay.

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.
